from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-2/play/users/u061/system/state/workspace/programs/task-5f2b70e4.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    ones = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 1]
    # Draw a 45-degree segment between diagonal 1 markers; preserve any 6 markers.
    for i, (r1, c1) in enumerate(ones):
        for r2, c2 in ones[i+1:]:
            if abs(r2-r1) == abs(c2-c1) and r2 != r1:
                dr = 1 if r2 > r1 else -1
                dc = 1 if c2 > c1 else -1
                r, c = r1, c1
                while True:
                    if out[r][c] != 6:
                        out[r][c] = 1
                    if (r, c) == (r2, c2):
                        break
                    r += dr; c += dc
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source,str(p),'exec'),globals())
